symptom: Swing Drift on a Slope is Large (While Swing Parking Brake is Applied)
detail_of_failure: The swing drift on a slope is large while the swing parking brake is applied.
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. Related information When the swing lock switch is set to the ON position or the swing parking brake cancel switch is in the usual position, the swing brake is activated, and the swing is fixed by the disc brake.
